messages:
sara: Quick sync: ops asked for a clearer "operator override" path in the console. Current flow is too hidden and we keep getting late-night pages when someone overwrote a flag without context.
tony: Oof. What failures are we trying to prevent? accidental wide-rollouts or silent temporary fixes?
sara: Both. We need: 1) lightweight approval for low-risk overrides, 2) a formal approval + justification for >10% audience changes, 3) timeboxed overrides with auto-expire.
lee: Tech constraints: overrides are applied via POST /configs/override today and we already accept metadata but console doesn't require justification. We could add enum fields: reason, risk_level, ticket_id, expires_at.
reliability-bot: perf-alert: suggest adding a preflight check hook that fails overrides if recent p95 delta > 30% for same route.
tony: Preflight is fine but owners will want to bypass in emergencies. We should allow bypass with a required human justification and a secondary signer for high-impact.
sara: Good call. Proposal: policy tiers: LOW (<1% traffic) bypass allowed, MEDIUM (1-10%) single approver required, HIGH (>10%) two approvers required + CI ticket link. All overrides must include expected rollback plan and TTL.
ops: Also add a telemetry snapshot at time of override: p50/p95, error-rate, recent change-rate. This makes postmortems easier.
lee: Implementation: console overlay forces the extra fields; backend validates approver list against org membership. We add an 'override_audit' record to telemetry ledger with the snapshot and justification.
console: UX note: show a small "impact indicator" calculated from traffic share and route-criticality. Make the approve button disabled until justification text is non-empty.
reliability-bot: Also surface whether a preview was run. If no preview, show a small warning and optional "run preview now" CTA.
sara: Ops playbook: require run-preview for MEDIUM/HIGH or explicit opt-out with reason. We'll iterate. I'll draft an RFC with schema + API sample and a console mock. Who wants to review?
tony: I'll take the API + auth/approval checks.
lee: I'll do the backend + ledger schema.
console: I'll mock the UI and wording.
sara: Thanks. I'll drop the RFC in here in ~24h. Please flag any edge cases (multi-tenant flags, tenant-scoped overrides) asap. :raised_hands:
